utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out for any repair drive updates while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Bring the drill and a couple screwdrivers if you’ve got them.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So, just to confirm, the repair drive is still happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, it’s still happening, but I want to double-check the timing and who’s bringing what so nothing gets missed.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — so it’s still on, just the timing and supplies need confirming?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m in; just point me where to bring the stuff, and I’ll do my best not to forget it this time.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great—bring it to my porch this afternoon, and I’ll sort it into the bins. If you’ve got tape, screws, or a wrench, those would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: You got it—I’ll bring it by your porch this afternoon. I think I’ve got some tape and a wrench somewhere, assuming I can find them.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — I’ll make sure we check the details before we do anything. What’s the first thing you want to confirm about the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I just want to confirm what needs fixing and when the repair drive starts—I’m a little out of the loop.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Of course — let’s confirm the list of items needing repair and the start time for the drive. If you have the flyer or message, I can help sort it out.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Jules, sorry I’m late—what’s the repair drive plan? I can still help if you need me.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: No worries—what do you need me to grab or do?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Gus — what needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can lend a hammer, a screwdriver set, and my step ladder if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That’d be a huge help, Gus — thanks. I can swing by and pick those up before the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule for the repair drive. What time are you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Faye — I’m thinking late afternoon, around 4:30, so folks can come by after school.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Ira. I appreciate it—just let me know when you hear anything, and I’ll keep my afternoon open.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Of course — I’ll keep my ears open and let you know as soon as I hear anything about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Have the repair-drive flyers gone out yet?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Not yet, but I can help get them out today.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — can you drop a stack at the corner store and the community board?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m happy to help spread the word about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll tell folks what’s needed and when to drop things off.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Uli — I’ve got the repair drive organized and I’m ready to help however I can. What do you want to tackle first?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. Could we start with the leaky kitchen tap?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll put the tap at the top of the list and line up whoever can help. If you know when it drips most, that’ll help us sort it faster.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a good bit of attention already. If you want, I can keep you posted on any updates I hear around the neighborhood.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing — I’ll keep my ears open and let you know if I hear anything new about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late—what do you need me to do for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries — can you help sort the donated tools and set them by the driveway? We’re keeping the repair drive moving and I’ll circle back with the rest of the plan.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure thing — I’ll sort the donated tools and set them by the driveway now.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help with the repair drive, but I’m keeping things low-key today. Just let me know what you need from me.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Uli — low-key works for me. I’ll keep it simple and let you know what needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what’s the repair drive for again?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It’s for gathering tools and supplies to help folks fix up things around the neighborhood.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Ah right — I’m in. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good — I can help connect folks and see who’s available for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules — that’d be really helpful. If you can check who’s available, I’ll make sure we’ve got the details sorted before we start.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll ask around and see who can help with the repair drive. Once I’ve got a sense of availability, I’ll let you know so we can line up the details.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I can help with the repair drive. What do you need me to take care of first?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — thanks, Mara. Could you start by checking the donated tools and seeing what’s still missing?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard the latest yet—how’s the repair drive going?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Pretty good so far — we’ve got a decent stack of donated tools and a few folks already signed up to help.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’s great to hear — sounds like it’s really coming together. If you hear what they still need, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Sam — can you help sort the donated items and label the boxes? That’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can do that. Just point me to the boxes and I’ll get started.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’d want to know the exact time, where to drop things off, and who’s coordinating it so we don’t miss anything.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: That makes sense—I'll get you the exact time, drop-off spot, and coordinator name before you come by.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Mina — once you have those details, I can plan around it and make sure I’m there at the right place and time.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m telling everyone about the repair drive—want me to put you on the invite list?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, please put me on the invite list — I can help keep track of supplies.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I'll add you right now and tell folks you can help with supplies. Thanks, Cleo!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what time is the repair drive happening?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—thanks, Faye. I’m still trying to pin that down, but I’ll check and get you the time as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good—just send me the time when you have it, and I’ll work around the school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll help keep the repair drive organized and make sure neighbors know what to bring. Let’s get a clear list together and set a simple time that works for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa — I can pass along whatever list we settle on and help spread the word. Just let me know the time, and I’ll keep an ear out.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great — let’s set it for Saturday at 10 a.m. in the community room, and I’ll put together the item list today.
